body.x: Since the 'Fourth Industrial Revolution' wasdiscussed at the World Economic Forum in 2016, government, business and publicattention has been steadily continuing. Recently, in line with the globalindustrial trends, companies in various fields are introducing products andsystems with smart technology.

At the 'TCT KOREA 2018' exhibition, which I recently participated in, I have been introduced various 3D printing technologies and products that match the keyword 'Fourth Industry'. It has attracted attention as it has released not only the already stable B2B products but also the B2C products that the public can see.

CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas from January 8 (Thursday) to 11 (Thursday) 2019, is expected to showcase the latest devices and industry trends by participating in a number of companies related to 3D printing.

3D printers can be used in medical,aerospace, engineering, and automotive industries and help produce prototypes priorto commercialization, said the official website of CES 2019 on the usefulnessof the 3D printing industry. In particular, it emphasized on 3D-printingartificial cornea manufacturing technology for medical use.

In May, researchers at Newcastle Universityin the UK developed a 3D printing technology capable of making artificialcorneas. Artificial cornea is produced in the form of making bio-ink bycombining alginate and collagen with healthy corneal stem cells.

"It takes less than 10 minutes to print the basic structure of a cornea," an official at the Newcastle University said. "But I think it will take a little more time until the actual commercialization," he said.

At present, when corneal donation islacking, artificial cornea manufacturing technology is expected to become aninnovative technology to help the sight recovery. This 3D printing technologywill be a new solution for various industries including medical. It is expectedthat the 3D printing industry will achieve significant results in the future.

On the other hand, AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met. MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
